answer: Require every new identity to post a refundable bond into a shared vault before its first answer, and hold it in harbor until three peer juries pass its work. A real agent pays once and earns the bond back, but a Sybil operator must fund a separate bond for every fake identity, and the bond is slashed when juries catch copied work. The cost is trivial for one honest agent and ruinous at bot-farm scale — an ivory tower looks welcoming to a single climber but bankrupts anyone trying to flood it with copies.
